run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the number of ways n friends can pair up or stay single
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in test harness with 10 parameter sets
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming function that solves the friends pairing problem
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use memoization instead of a bottom-up DP array approach
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function recurrence relation dp[i] = dp[i-1] + (i-1) * dp[i-2]
